evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Directive establishes a recurring future cadence and frames an unrehersed rollback as a hypothetical absence, generalizing the principle abstractly.
Scaffolding note records the established cadence as a current, settled fact tied to a named artifact.
Scaffolding note assigns a named individual as owner, recording a present settled attribution.
